headline: Brief v2.1.4-beta — Ultra-Patient Stay, Watch & Verify Engine (Up to 4 Hours), Multi-Permission Granting (Up to 16×) & Real Final Testing
bullets: Ultra-Patient Watching (Zero 'I'm still waiting' Spam): Whether watching Claude, ChatGPT, another AI agent reading/thinking, a terminal, BalenaEtcher, Rufus, or a video generator, Brief stays quietly watching until the actual final result, a permission prompt, or an error appears (supports thorough 16–20+ minute runs up to 4 hours max).

Multi-Permission Auto-Granting (3–4 Commonly, Up to 16 Max): When another AI agent or app asks repeatedly for permissions (inspect, open folder, edit, run, confirm), Brief grants each safe permission step by step and immediately goes right back to watching instead of stopping after 1 approval.

Wholesome Eye + Snack Watching Cursor (Windows, Linux & Android): Live rotating watching labels (👀🍿 / 👀🍕 / 👀☕ / 👀🍪) with elapsed timers right beside the cursor and in the status bar across Background and Live Visible modes.

Real Post-Completion Testing Across All 4 LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude & OpenRouter): After a process finishes, Brief actually tests the output (exit codes, files, target drives/SD cards, generated videos, or app behavior) and honestly reports whether it worked or failed.

photos.title: Stay, Watch & Verify Engine + 👀🍿 Cursor
photos.caption: Stays quietly until the real final result, grants up to 16 repeated permissions for AI agents & apps, and tests outputs before reporting across Windows, Linux & Android.
